ui.src/main.tsx: bootstrap: imports the global stylesheets, calls prepareDocument and bridgeNavigation from boot.ts (tested) and mounts Widget, Toaster or App into #root by the flags they return
ui.src/types.ts: type-only: API payload types and interfaces, emits no JavaScript
ui.src/plugins/types.ts: type-only: plugin contract types, emits no JavaScript
ui.src/views/settings/types.ts: type-only: settings tab prop types, emits no JavaScript

server.src/plugins/types.ts: type-only: plugin contract types, emits no JavaScript
server.src/index.ts: bootstrap: five-line entrypoint that imports upgrade-backup first, then calls startHub(hubOptionsFrom(config, appVersion, process.env)); the wiring lives in app.ts and is tested

desktop.src/main.rs: bootstrap: five-line binary entrypoint that only calls vbss_cchub_lib::run()
desktop.src/app.rs: Tauri wiring: plugins, builder, tray menu items, the restart command and the AppHandle/window calls (show, hide, focus, emit, exit, shutdown on exit) that need a real AppHandle and webview; the tray, widget-toggle and close-to-hide decisions and the supervisor logic live in lib.rs and are unit tested
desktop.src/tests.rs: unit tests of lib.rs (cfg(test) module), not product code
